title: Hold a licence to provide child care
what: Provide a child care service (one outside the National Law) at a place only under a licence for that place.

sources.title: Child Care Services Act 2007 (WA)
sources.publisher: WA Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not provide a child care service at a place except under and in accordance with a licence authorising the provision of the service at that place

administration.who: CEO of the department administering the Child Care Services Act 2007 (WA)
